summary: Consistently positive across the window and improving. The champion volunteers praise unprompted and has started referring the team internally. Nothing in the conversations suggests risk. Note for the reader: this account's renewal paperwork has not moved since June, which no call would tell you.

readings.source: Recorded call — Routing rebuild kickoff review
readings.speaker: Dana Whitfield
readings.quote: This is the first time anyone has actually shown me the routing logic in a way my team can read.
readings.claude_note: Positive but early — praise is for the approach, not yet for an outcome.

readings.speaker: Iris Kaminski
readings.quote: We are behind on the test cases but that is on us, not you.
readings.claude_note: Neutral working-session tone. Slippage is self-attributed, so this is not a complaint.

readings.source: Recorded call — Territory rules UAT walkthrough
readings.speaker: Iris Kaminski
readings.quote: Every single one of the 40 test cases passed on the first run. I have never had that happen.
readings.claude_note: Strong, specific, outcome-based praise from the person closest to the work.

readings.speaker: Grant Mbeki
readings.quote: Speed to first touch went from two days to under an hour. That is the number I care about and it moved.
readings.claude_note: Executive-level praise tied to a business metric, in a business review. The strongest form of positive signal available.

readings.speaker: Iris Kaminski
readings.quote: Nothing blocking this week, just housekeeping.
readings.claude_note: Routine. No signal either way.

readings.speaker: Dana Whitfield
readings.quote: I have already recommended you to two other VPs here. You have made me look good this year.
readings.claude_note: Champion is spending internal political capital on the relationship. This is as healthy as sentiment gets — and it is not a signature.

summary: Deteriorated sharply from March onward. Two explicit escalations about a reporting discrepancy, then the champion stopped appearing entirely and the account went quiet after 28 May. The remaining contact is cooperative but has no authority.

readings.speaker: Marcus Feld
readings.quote: We are where I expected to be, roughly.
readings.claude_note: Flat. 'Roughly' is doing some work here but there is no complaint to point at yet.

readings.speaker: Marcus Feld
readings.quote: This is the third time we have rebuilt the same report and I still cannot hand it to my CFO.
readings.claude_note: First clear dissatisfaction, tied to a repeated failure and an audience that matters.

readings.speaker: Tobias Lund
readings.quote: Marcus asked me to say this formally: the numbers in the dashboard do not match the numbers in the CRM, and we have lost confidence in both.
readings.claude_note: Explicit escalation language, delivered on behalf of an absent senior stakeholder. Trust in the deliverable is stated as lost.

readings.speaker: Tobias Lund
readings.quote: I do not think I am the right person for this conversation any more. I will find out who is.
readings.claude_note: Second escalation and an ownership vacuum. Nobody replaced Marcus in the conversation, and the account goes silent after this call.

summary: Strong and stable. The champion is engaged, the CRO showed up to the business review and asked forward-looking questions, and an expansion conversation is live. No escalations in the window.

readings.source: Recorded call — Forecast redesign working session
readings.speaker: Alina Okonkwo
readings.quote: You caught something in our stage definitions that we have been arguing about internally for a year.
readings.claude_note: Credibility-building praise. Positive but about diagnosis, not results.

readings.source: Recorded call — Forecast redesign go-live readiness
readings.speaker: Alina Okonkwo
readings.quote: We went live a week early and nothing broke. My team is asking what else we can put through this process.
readings.claude_note: Outcome praise plus pull for more work — the cleanest possible expansion signal.

readings.speaker: Rebecca Tran
readings.quote: Forecast accuracy is inside five points for the first time since I joined. Keep going.
readings.claude_note: Executive sponsor, business metric, explicit mandate to continue.

readings.speaker: Owen Delacroix
readings.quote: The handover docs were good enough that I did not need to ask you anything for three weeks.
readings.claude_note: Quiet, credible praise about self-sufficiency.

readings.speaker: Alina Okonkwo
readings.quote: Rebecca asked me to get the analytics module into next year's budget. That came from her, not me.
readings.claude_note: Expansion pulled by the economic buyer without prompting.

summary: Frustrated but engaged. A duplicate-assignment defect has recurred twice and produced two escalations, and the VP-level champion has not joined a call since 21 May — the account is now being run by a director and an admin. The contract runs to April 2027, so there is time to fix this, which is exactly why it should be fixed now.

readings.source: Recorded call — Lead routing design review
readings.speaker: Hollis Bennett
readings.quote: This is a much better design than the one we wrote ourselves.
readings.claude_note: Positive start, champion personally invested in the design.

readings.speaker: Ray Okafor
readings.quote: On track as far as I can tell.
readings.claude_note: Neutral status language, no enthusiasm and no complaint.

readings.source: Recorded call — Escalation: duplicate lead assignment
readings.speaker: Hollis Bennett
readings.quote: Two reps called the same account on the same morning. I need this treated as urgent, not as a backlog item.
readings.claude_note: Explicit escalation with a named business consequence. Champion is still fighting for the account here — this is the last call he attends.

readings.source: Recorded call — Routing rules rework session
readings.speaker: Ray Okafor
readings.quote: We are spending our Tuesdays on this instead of on the pipeline review.
readings.claude_note: Cost-of-ownership complaint rather than a quality complaint.

readings.speaker: Ray Okafor
readings.quote: Quiet week. Nothing new broke.
readings.claude_note: Neutral, though the framing assumes breakage is the normal state.

readings.source: Recorded call — Escalation follow-up: duplicate assignment recurrence
readings.speaker: Ray Okafor
readings.quote: It happened again on Monday. Hollis is going to ask me why we are still paying for this.
readings.claude_note: Second escalation on the same defect, and the first time the spend itself is questioned out loud. The absent champion is invoked as the person who will ask.
